question: At a lakeside plant, flux is described to a trainee reviewing membrane output. Which statement best defines membrane flux?

options: Volume of permeate per unit membrane area per unit time
Pressure applied across the membrane surface each hour
Volume of concentrate returned to the raw water source
Mass of solids retained on the membrane surface each day
